seed_reuse: Approved by the Stronger-3 main session: all three pairings use arm A's registered tournament seeds; the fallback seed audit is not used.
recipe_caveat: Both arms run the identical outcome-PPO config, including the mixed-v2 retention anchors (controller-retention-bank-v1, coefficient 0.1, max anchor-KL increase 0.03 over each arm's own initial KL). The retention gradient pulls both arms toward the same anchor teachers; arm B starts farther from them than the champion-distilled arm A, so it feels a larger pull. This can shrink the A-B difference; a NO_DIFFERENCE_SHOWN verdict therefore does not show the initializations are equivalent without anchors.
